newsitem.title: PORTUGAL: Portucel soars on restructuring report.
newsitem.headline: Portucel soars on restructuring report.

text.p: Shares in Portucel Industrial jumped 5.21 percent to 1,110 escudos on reports of progress in plans to restructure Portugal's pulp and paper sector.
"Clearly the shares are rising on news that the restructuring is advancing and that Portucel could be the central holding in the process," said one trader.
The Diario Economico reported on Thursday that a consortium formed by Salomon Brothers and Banco Chemical had been chosen to prepare the restructuring.

The newspaper cited two hypotheses for the reorganisation. One would be the creation of a new holding to take the state's stakes in Portucel, Soporcel and Inapa which would subsequently be privatised. The other would be the acquisition by Portucel of the 50.4 percent of Soporcel held by state savings bank Caixa Geral de Depositos.
One trader said that the rise in Portucel shares brought the stock more into line with its book value which would be around 1,130-1,140 escudos per share.
The share touched an historic high of 1,150 escudos earlier in the session. --Lisbon bureau 3511-3150035
